advanced_mode_description: Shows protocol-level signals, capability matrices, and Raw JSON throughout the app.
cancel_requested_message: Waiting for the operation to stop.
credential_delete_warning_destructive: Deleting this discoverable passkey is destructive and cannot be undone.
credential_delete_warning_irreversible: The relying party may stop working until the passkey is recreated.
cred_protect_level_2: Level 2 · UV optional with passkey list
credential_update_no_changes: Change at least one user field before previewing the update.
credential_update_warning_mutation: Changing this information may prevent you from signing in with this passkey.
credential_update_warning_scope: The passkey ID and relying-party binding remain unchanged.
failure_algorithm_unsupported: The authenticator does not support the requested algorithm.
failure_always_uv_already_target: Always-UV is already in the requested state.
failure_always_uv_state_unknown: The current always-UV state could not be determined.
failure_assertion_continuation_unavailab: The authenticator cannot return the next assertion.
failure_assertion_not_allowed: The authenticator does not allow this assertion in its current state.
failure_attested_credential_data_missing: The authenticator response does not contain attested passkey data.
failure_authenticator_action_timeout: The authenticator action did not finish in time.
failure_authenticator_busy: The authenticator is busy processing another request.
failure_authenticator_config_storage_ful: The authenticator configuration storage is full.
failure_authenticator_config_unsupported: The authenticator does not support configuration commands.
failure_authenticator_no_operations: The authenticator has no operation available to continue.
failure_authenticator_operation_not_allo: The authenticator does not allow this operation in its current state.
failure_authenticator_operation_pending: The authenticator operation is still pending.
failure_authenticator_processing: The authenticator is still processing the request.
failure_authenticator_timeout: The authenticator did not respond in time.
failure_bio_database_full: The biometric enrollment database is full.
failure_bio_enrollment_not_found: The biometric enrollment was not found.
failure_bio_no_enrollments: The authenticator has no biometric enrollments.
failure_bio_template_id_invalid: The biometric template identifier is invalid.
failure_bio_template_id_required: A biometric template identifier is required.
failure_bio_unsupported: The authenticator does not support biometric enrollment.
failure_credential_changes_required: Specify at least one passkey change.
failure_credential_invalid: The authenticator rejected the passkey as invalid.
failure_credential_management_unsupporte: The authenticator does not support passkey management.
failure_credential_not_found: The requested passkey was not found.
failure_credential_store_full: The authenticator passkey store is full.
failure_ctap_cbor_invalid: The CTAP request contains invalid CBOR.
failure_ctap_cbor_type_invalid: A CTAP CBOR value has an unexpected type.
failure_ctap_command_invalid: The authenticator does not recognize the CTAP command.
failure_ctap_extension_error: A CTAP extension returned an error.
failure_ctap_integrity_failure: The authenticator detected a CTAP integrity failure.
failure_ctap_length_invalid: The CTAP request length is invalid.
failure_ctap_limit_exceeded: The CTAP request exceeds an authenticator limit.
failure_ctap_lock_required: The CTAP channel must be locked for this request.
failure_ctap_option_invalid: The CTAP option value is invalid for this request.
failure_ctap_option_unsupported: The authenticator does not support the requested CTAP option.
failure_ctap_other_error: The authenticator returned an unspecified CTAP error.
failure_ctap_parameter_invalid: A CTAP request parameter is invalid.
failure_ctap_parameter_missing: A required CTAP request parameter is missing.
failure_ctap_request_too_large: The CTAP request is too large for the authenticator.
failure_ctap_reserved_status: The authenticator returned a reserved CTAP status.
failure_ctap_sequence_invalid: The CTAP message sequence is invalid.
failure_ctap_spec_violation: The authenticator returned data that violates the CTAP specification.
failure_ctap_subcommand_invalid: The authenticator does not recognize the CTAP subcommand.
failure_ctap_vendor_error: The authenticator returned a vendor-specific CTAP error.
failure_get_info_unsupported: The authenticator does not support the GetInfo command.
failure_interaction_canceled: The requested user interaction was canceled.
failure_interaction_handler_required: An interaction handler is required for this operation.
failure_internal_error: The operation failed because of an internal error.
failure_large_blob_array_invalid: The authenticator returned an invalid large-blob array.
failure_large_blob_array_too_large: The large-blob array exceeds the authenticator limit.
failure_large_blob_cbor_invalid: The large blob is not valid CBOR.
failure_large_blob_decode_mode_unsupport: The requested large-blob decoding mode is not supported.
failure_large_blob_json_invalid: The large blob is not valid JSON.
failure_large_blob_key_invalid: The passkey contains an invalid large-blob key.
failure_large_blob_key_missing: The passkey does not contain a large-blob key.
failure_large_blob_storage_full: The authenticator large-blob storage is full.
failure_large_blob_unsupported: The authenticator does not support large blobs.
failure_large_blob_utf8_invalid: The large blob is not valid UTF-8.
failure_large_blob_write_sequence_invali: The large-blob write sequence is invalid.
failure_mds_aaguid_invalid: The AAGUID is invalid for metadata lookup.
failure_mds_fetch_failed: Authenticator metadata could not be downloaded.
failure_min_pin_length_decrease_not_allo: The minimum PIN length cannot be decreased.
failure_min_pin_length_unsupported: The authenticator does not support minimum PIN length configuration.
failure_operation_unsupported: The requested operation is not supported.
failure_pin_already_configured: A PIN is already configured on the authenticator.
failure_pin_change_required: The authenticator requires the PIN to be changed before this operation.
failure_pin_not_configured: No PIN is configured on the authenticator.
failure_pin_policy_violation: The PIN does not satisfy the authenticator policy.
failure_pin_required: Enter the authenticator PIN to continue.
failure_pin_unsupported: The authenticator does not support PIN operations.
failure_pin_uv_auth_token_required: A PIN/UV authentication token is required.
failure_pin_uv_permission_unauthorized: The PIN/UV token does not authorize this operation.
failure_public_key_credential_algorithm_: A public-key algorithm for the passkey is required.
failure_public_key_credential_parameters: Public-key parameters for the passkey are required.
failure_reset_touch_timeout: The authenticator was not touched before the reset timed out.
failure_reset_window_expired: The authenticator reset window has expired.
failure_transport_mode_unsupported: The requested transport mode is not supported.
failure_transport_permission_denied: Permission to access the authenticator transport was denied.
failure_transport_proxy_unavailable: The authenticator transport proxy is unavailable.
failure_user_action_pending: The authenticator is waiting for a user action.
failure_user_action_timeout: The required user action did not occur in time.
failure_user_id_hex_invalid: The hexadecimal user identifier is invalid.
failure_user_presence_required: Confirm presence on the authenticator, then retry the operation. For an NFC key, remove it and present it again before retrying.
failure_user_verification_blocked: User verification is blocked on the authenticator.
failure_verification_flow_unsupported: The requested verification flow is not supported.
interaction_pin_description: Enter the PIN to authorize this operation.
interaction_pin_power_cycle_required: Reconnect the authenticator before trying the PIN again.
interaction_touch_description: Continue when you are ready to touch the authenticator.
interaction_user_verification_descriptio: Continue when you are ready, then complete verification on the authenticator.
lab_verification_attestation_evidence_de: Checks the attestation object, format, type, statement, and its cryptographic proof.
lab_verification_authenticator_data_desc: Checks the returned data against parsed authData, the RP ID hash, UP/UV requirements, attested credential data, and the selected credential algorithm.
lab_verification_credential_authenticato: Checks assertion count and credential selection, parsed authData, the RP ID hash, UP/UV requirements, and the absence of attested credential data.
lab_verification_cryptographic_proof_des: Resolves one verification record, parses its COSE public key, and verifies the signature over authenticator data and the client data hash.
lab_verification_description: Local structural and signature checks. This is not relying-party ceremony validation.
lab_verification_error: Local verification could not be completed.
lab_verification_material_description: Passkey ID, COSE public key, and the previous signature counter. These values are used only by local verification and are never sent to the authenticator.
lab_verification_material_empty: No verification key is available. Signature verification will be unavailable.
lab_verification_material_not_sent: Local verification data · not sent to the authenticator
lab_verification_signature_counter_descr: Compares the current signCount with the previous value when one was supplied. A counter that did not advance is a warning signal, not proof of cloning.
lab_verification_stage_failed_summary: One or more checks in this stage failed.
lab_verification_stage_loading_summary: Checks for this stage are in progress.
lab_verification_stage_neutral_summary: No evaluative result is available for this stage.
lab_verification_stage_not_applicable_su: This stage does not apply to the result.
lab_verification_stage_pending_summary: This stage is waiting for the preceding checks.
lab_verification_stage_unavailable_summa: Some checks in this stage could not be completed.
lab_verification_stage_verified_summary: All completed checks in this stage passed.
lab_verification_stage_warning_summary: The stage completed with a warning.
lab_attestation_trust_description: Certificate-path validation against attestation roots from the verified MDS entry. Authenticator status reports remain visible as separate trust signals.
lab_attestation_trust_error: MDS attestation trust could not be evaluated.
lab_allow_list_description: Leave empty to let the authenticator choose a passkey.
lab_attestation_formats_description: One supported IANA attestation format identifier per line, in preference order. Leave empty to omit.
lab_builder_description: The Lab acts as the WebAuthn client and serializes type, challenge, origin, crossOrigin, and topOrigin when applicable.
lab_client_data_section_description: Choose how the WebAuthn client context is produced before it is hashed for the authenticator.
lab_cose_algorithms_description: One unique non-zero integer per line, in preference order.
lab_cross_origin_description: Enable when the WebAuthn call is cross-origin with its ancestors.
lab_description: Create a passkey, review the exact request, then exercise it with an assertion.
lab_duplicate_algorithm: Each COSE algorithm may appear only once.
lab_duplicate_attestation_format: Each attestation format may appear only once.
lab_enterprise_attestation_description: CTAP enterpriseAttestation: omit, vendor-facilitated (1), or platform-managed (2).
lab_exclude_list_description: Passkey IDs to exclude, one hex value per line.
lab_get_assertion_description: Run authentication and inspect every assertion returned by the authenticator.
lab_generated_client_data_description: Read-only JSON serialized from the browser-style fields above.
lab_handoff_complete_message: The passkey was added to the GetAssertion allow list.
lab_handoff_failed: Could not derive the previewSign ARKG-P256 key
lab_handoff_replace_description: The RP differs or GetAssertion already has a result. Continuing replaces its RP and allow list with the created passkey and clears that run.
lab_insecure_origin: Use an HTTPS origin or http://localhost.
lab_invalid_attestation_format: Enter a non-empty attestation format identifier.
lab_invalid_algorithm: Enter a non-zero integer COSE algorithm ID.
lab_invalid_descriptor: Enter a valid passkey ID in hexadecimal.
lab_invalid_user_presence: MakeCredential user presence may be omitted or true, but not false.
lab_large_blob_mode_tooltip: Choose whether GetAssertion reads the existing direct large blob or writes the supplied bytes.
lab_large_blob_support_tooltip: Preferred allows creation without direct large-blob support; required makes support mandatory.
lab_ctap_extensions_description: Raw extension inputs sent to the authenticator through CTAP.
lab_cred_blob_get_tooltip: Sends getCredBlob: true and asks the authenticator to return the blob for the selected passkey.
lab_cred_protect_enforce_tooltip: When enabled, passkey creation should fail rather than ignore an unsupported protection policy.
lab_cred_protect_policy_tooltip: Chooses whether user verification is optional, required when the passkey ID is not supplied, or required for every use.
lab_extension_conflict: The selected raw HMAC-secret input conflicts with the WebAuthn PRF request.
lab_extension_cred_blob_create_descripti: Stores a small RP-defined opaque blob with the new passkey for retrieval during a later assertion.
lab_extension_cred_blob_get_description: Requests the opaque blob stored with the selected passkey.
lab_extension_cred_props_description: Reports whether the newly created passkey is discoverable through the client extension result.
lab_extension_cred_protect_description: Stores a policy with the passkey that controls when user verification is required to discover or use it.
lab_extension_hmac_secret_create_descrip: Asks the authenticator to associate passkey-scoped HMAC secret material with the new passkey.
lab_extension_hmac_secret_get_descriptio: Evaluates the selected passkey's HMAC secret for one or two 32-byte salts and returns passkey-bound outputs.
lab_extension_hmac_secret_mc_description: Evaluates the new passkey's HMAC secret during MakeCredential; hmac-secret must also be requested.
lab_extension_large_blob_create_descript: Requests direct per-passkey largeBlob support during passkey creation.
lab_extension_large_blob_get_description: Reads or writes the direct per-passkey largeBlob value during assertion.
lab_extension_min_pin_length_description: Requests the authenticator's current minimum PIN length during passkey creation; only authorized RP IDs receive it.
lab_extension_pin_complexity_policy_desc: Requests whether a PIN complexity policy is configured; only authorized RP IDs receive the result.
lab_extension_prf_description: Maps the WebAuthn PRF request to the authenticator's hmac-secret extension, where the passkey-bound function is evaluated.
lab_extension_preview_sign_create_descri: Generates a passkey-bound signing key for the requested COSE algorithms and returns its handle, public key, and attestation.
lab_extension_preview_sign_get_descripti: Uses one previewSign key handle to sign the supplied prehashed bytes for every passkey in the allow list. ESP256-split-ARKG expects a 32-byte SHA-256 digest.
lab_extension_payment_description: Requests the WebAuthn payment flow and its CTAP thirdPartyPayment extension input.
lab_hmac_secret_create_tooltip: Sends hmac-secret: true so the authenticator confirms secret material is associated with the new passkey.
lab_min_pin_length_tooltip: Sends minPinLength: true and requests the current minimum PIN length in Unicode code points.
lab_pin_complexity_policy_tooltip: Sends pinComplexityPolicy: true and requests whether a PIN complexity policy is configured.
lab_prf_evaluation_tooltip: When enabled, evaluates the new passkey's PRF during registration. Some authenticators only return PRF results during an assertion.
lab_prf_global_evaluation_tooltip: Uses these PRF inputs for the selected passkey unless a matching per-passkey override is present.
lab_execution_description: Local execution behavior; this is not serialized into clientDataJSON or the CTAP request.
lab_prf_credential_overrides_description: Add one override for each allow-list passkey. A single CTAP request requires every possible passkey to resolve to identical PRF inputs.
lab_prf_credential_not_allowed: The PRF override passkey must be present in the allow list.
lab_preview_sign_additional_arguments_de: Algorithm-specific CBOR map encoded as hexadecimal. Filled automatically when an ESP256-split-ARKG key is handed off.
lab_preview_sign_key_handle_description: Hex key handle returned by previewSign during MakeCredential.
lab_webauthn_client_extensions_descripti: Inputs and outputs defined by the WebAuthn client contract.
lab_inspection_failed: Authenticator capabilities could not be inspected. Extensions can still be sent.
lab_invalid_origin: Enter an HTTP(S) origin without a path, query, or fragment.
lab_make_credential_description: Build a registration request, preview it, then confirm the reviewed snapshot.
lab_make_rk_tooltip: Controls CTAP options.rk. True creates a discoverable passkey; false creates a non-discoverable passkey. If omitted, CTAP defaults to false.
lab_make_up_tooltip: User presence is required for MakeCredential. When options.up is omitted, it defaults to true. Explicit true is valid for CTAP 2.1+ but may be rejected by CTAP 2.0. False is invalid.
lab_get_up_tooltip: Controls CTAP options.up for GetAssertion. Omitted and true both require user presence. False is useful for direct-CTAP pre-flight checks; assertions returned through WebAuthn require user presence.
lab_raw_description: The Lab passes these exact UTF-8 bytes as clientDataJSON. They may be invalid JSON; the bytes are hashed without normalization.
lab_raw_json_warning: This text is not valid JSON. The lab will still send its exact UTF-8 bytes.
lab_review_notice: The form is locked to the exact reviewed request. Edit to make changes.
lab_rp_id_origin_mismatch: RP ID must equal the origin host or be its registrable domain suffix.
lab_top_origin_description: The origin of the top-level browsing context; serialized only when crossOrigin is true.
lab_user_id_too_long: User ID must not exceed 64 bytes.
lab_uv_tooltip: Controls CTAP options.uv. True requests user verification; false explicitly does not request it; Auto omits the option. In CTAP 2.1, options.uv is deprecated in favor of pinUvAuthParam. Authenticator policy may still require verification.
lab_value_too_long: The value exceeds the authenticator's reported maximum length and will be omitted from the CTAP request.
lab_verification_flow_description: Controls how a pinUvAuthToken is obtained when one is needed. Auto uses built-in user verification when available, otherwise asks for a PIN; PIN skips built-in verification and asks for a PIN immediately.
large_blob_cleanup_description: Remove orphaned and nonconforming entries from the physical array.
large_blob_cleanup_noop: No orphaned or nonconforming entries need cleanup.
large_blob_cleanup_warning_unmatched: Orphaned and nonconforming entries will be removed from the shared array.
large_blob_delete_noop: This passkey has no large blob to delete.
large_blob_delete_warning: Existing large-blob bytes for this passkey will be deleted.
large_blob_payload_placeholder: Paste text, JSON, or hex payload
large_blob_replace_warning: Existing large-blob bytes for this passkey will be replaced.
large_blob_shared_array_warning: This operation rewrites the authenticator's shared serialized large-blob array.
large_blob_cleanup_only: This physical entry can only be inspected or removed by cleanup.
large_blobs_reloaded: Large blobs reloaded from the authenticator
large_blobs_no_filtered_results_message: Adjust the search or entry-state filter to see array entries.
large_blobs_not_loaded_message: Load the physical serialized large-blob array from the authenticator.
large_blobs_search_placeholder: Search index, state, RP, user, or credential ID
large_blobs_stale_message: The last successfully loaded data remains visible. Reload large blobs to try again.
large_blobs_stale_title: Large blob inventory could not be refreshed
large_blobs_unsupported_message: This authenticator does not expose the authenticatorLargeBlobs command.
matrix_desc_aaguid_model: Authenticator model identifier; identical values identify the same authenticator model.
matrix_desc_algorithms: Passkey-generation algorithms, ordered from most preferred to least preferred when reported; if present, the list must be non-empty and contain no duplicate entries.
matrix_desc_always_uv: alwaysUv reports Always Require User Verification support and whether it is currently enabled.
matrix_desc_attestation_formats: Supported attestation statement formats; support for none is implied and the string 'none' must be omitted.
matrix_desc_bio_enroll: bioEnroll reports authenticatorBioEnrollment support and whether at least one enrollment exists.
matrix_desc_bio_enroll_preview: FIDO_2_1_PRE prototype bio-enrollment command support and current enrollment state.
matrix_desc_bio_modality: Bio sensor modality reported by the optional sensor query.
matrix_desc_client_pin_absent: No ClientPIN capability was reported; ClientPIN is not built-in user verification.
matrix_desc_client_pin_not_set: The authenticator accepts a client-provided PIN, but no PIN is set yet.
matrix_desc_client_pin_set: The authenticator accepts a client-provided PIN and a PIN is currently set.
matrix_desc_config_commands: Supported authenticatorConfig subcommand identifiers; an empty reported list is allowed.
matrix_desc_cred_blob: Small RP-provided opaque data stored directly with a passkey.
matrix_desc_cred_mgmt_preview: FIDO_2_1_PRE prototype passkey management command support.
matrix_desc_cred_mgmt_ro: perCredMgmtRO=true means PIN/UV tokens can request the read-only passkey-management permission.
matrix_desc_cred_protect: Lets an RP request a passkey protection policy during passkey creation.
matrix_desc_device_firmware: Firmware version reported through the authenticator vendor protocol.
matrix_desc_attachment_id: Workbench selector for the authenticator's current transport attachment.
matrix_desc_device_model: Canonical model identity reported through the vendor protocol.
matrix_desc_device_serial: Full canonical serial reported through the vendor protocol.
matrix_desc_device_vendor: Authenticator vendor reported by the identity provider.
matrix_desc_token2_appearance: Device appearance reported by Token2 firmware.
matrix_desc_token2_capabilities_known: Whether Token2 capability and configuration state was reported.
matrix_desc_token2_capability: Normalized capability or configuration state reported by the Token2 resolver.
matrix_desc_token2_fido_version: FIDO version reported by Token2 firmware.
matrix_desc_token2_identity: Full serial-number identity returned by the Token2 resolver.
matrix_desc_token2_interface_state: Current Token2 interface state when reported by the device.
matrix_desc_token2_interface_state_known: Whether current Token2 interface state was reported.
matrix_desc_token2_model: Model-catalog metadata matched from the Token2 serial number.
matrix_desc_token2_product_id: USB product identifier correlated by the Token2 resolver.
matrix_desc_yubico_device_flags: Raw device-flags bitmap from Yubico device information.
matrix_desc_yubico_unknown_field: Unrecognized TLV field preserved from Yubico device information.
matrix_desc_enabled_applications: Applications reported as enabled on the {interface} interface by vendor metadata.
matrix_desc_encrypted_credential_store_s: Encrypted 128-bit passkey-store state returned only when a persistent PIN/UV auth token is available.
matrix_desc_encrypted_device_identifier: Encrypted 128-bit device identifier returned only when a persistent PIN/UV auth token is available.
matrix_desc_ep: ep reports enterprise attestation capability and whether it is currently enabled.
matrix_desc_fido_certification: FIDO Authenticator certification level hint, reported as integer level 1 through 6; plus levels are encoded as even numbers.
matrix_desc_firmware_version: Firmware version for the authenticator model identified by AAGUID; authenticators must increase it on firmware changes.
matrix_desc_force_pin_not_required: PIN token subcommands are not blocked by a required PIN change.
matrix_desc_force_pin_required: PIN token subcommands return errors until the PIN is changed successfully.
matrix_desc_hmac_secret: Lets a platform derive passkey-scoped symmetric secrets during assertion.
matrix_desc_hmac_secret_mc: Applies hmac-secret behavior during passkey creation; requires hmac-secret support.
matrix_desc_identity_resolution: State of optional hardware identity resolution for this attachment.
matrix_desc_large_blob_capacity: Maximum serialized large-blob array size; required when authenticatorLargeBlobs is supported and otherwise must be absent.
matrix_desc_large_blob_extension_item: Authenticator-managed per-passkey large blob extension for makeCredential/getAssertion.
matrix_desc_large_blob_key: Per-passkey key support for entries in the serialized large-blob array.
matrix_desc_large_blob_key_extension_ite: Returns a per-passkey key used by platforms with the serialized large-blob array.
matrix_desc_large_blobs_command: options.largeBlobs=true means the authenticatorLargeBlobs command is supported and the largeBlob extension path must not be used.
matrix_desc_long_touch_for_reset: Reports support and state for requiring a reset touch of at least five seconds.
matrix_desc_make_cred_uv_required: Requires some form of user verification for non-discoverable passkey creation.
matrix_desc_make_cred_uv_skipped: Allows non-discoverable passkey creation without user verification when the platform requests it.
matrix_desc_max_credblob_length: Maximum credBlob payload size; must be present iff credBlob is supported and at least 32 bytes when present.
matrix_desc_max_credential_id_length: Maximum passkey ID length supported by the authenticator; must be greater than zero when present.
matrix_desc_max_credential_list_count: Maximum number of passkey IDs accepted in one request list; must be greater than zero when present.
matrix_desc_max_msg_size: Maximum CTAP message size the authenticator supports; absent defaults to 1024 bytes.
matrix_desc_max_pin: Maximum ClientPIN length in Unicode code points; encoded PIN input must still fit within 63 bytes.
matrix_desc_max_rpids_for_set_min_pin_le: Maximum extra RP IDs accepted by setMinPINLength for minPinLength and PIN complexity visibility; must be present iff setMinPINLength is supported.
matrix_desc_min_pin_length: Current minimum ClientPIN length in Unicode code points; required when ClientPIN is supported and otherwise must be absent.
matrix_desc_min_pin_length_extension: Reports the current minimum ClientPIN length to authorized RPs during passkey creation.
matrix_desc_no_mc_ga_permissions_false: PIN-derived tokens may be used for makeCredential/getAssertion permissions.
matrix_desc_no_mc_ga_permissions_true: PIN-derived tokens lack makeCredential/getAssertion permissions; platforms should not fall back to ClientPIN for those permissions.
matrix_desc_pin_complexity_extension: Reports whether an authorized RP is subject to the current PIN complexity policy.
matrix_desc_pin_complexity_policy: Reports support and state for an additional current PIN complexity policy beyond minPINLength.
matrix_desc_pin_complexity_policy_url: URL the platform may show for more information about the enforced PIN policy.
matrix_desc_pin_uv_auth_token: Supports permission-scoped PIN/UV auth tokens; PIN-derived tokens require clientPin=true, UV-derived tokens require uv=true.
matrix_desc_pin_uv_protocols: Supported PIN/UV auth protocol versions in decreasing authenticator preference; if present, the list must be non-empty and unique.
matrix_desc_preview_sign: Generates a passkey-bound signing key and uses its opaque handle to sign caller-supplied bytes during assertion.
matrix_desc_platform_attachment: plat=true means the authenticator is attached to this client platform; absent defaults to false.
matrix_desc_preferred_platform_uv_attemp: Preferred number of built-in UV token attempts before falling back to PIN or showing an error; must be greater than zero when present.
matrix_desc_remaining_discoverable_crede: Estimated remaining discoverable passkey capacity using maximally sized future passkeys.
matrix_desc_reset_transports: AuthenticatorTransport values over which authenticatorReset is supported; if present, the list must be non-empty and unique.
matrix_desc_rk: rk=true means the authenticator can create discoverable passkeys and answer without an allowList.
matrix_desc_set_min_pin_length: Supports the setMinPINLength subcommand; this option may only appear with ClientPIN or authenticator PIN entry via built-in UV.
matrix_desc_smart_card_atr: Answer to Reset observed for the card currently in the reader.
matrix_desc_smart_card_reader: PC/SC reader used as the connection endpoint; this is not the card model.
matrix_desc_supported_applications: Applications reported as supported on the {interface} interface by vendor metadata.
matrix_desc_third_party_payment: Marks passkeys that may be used for third-party payment authentication.
matrix_desc_transport_fallback: AuthenticatorTransport values reported by getInfo, falling back to discovery metadata.
matrix_desc_transport_getinfo: AuthenticatorTransport values reported by getInfo; if present, the list must be non-empty and unique.
matrix_desc_up_false: up=false means the authenticator cannot test user presence; absent defaults to true.
matrix_desc_up_true: up=true or absent means the authenticator can test user presence.
matrix_desc_uv_absent: No built-in user verification capability was reported. A device that only supports ClientPIN must not report uv.
matrix_desc_uv_acfg: uvAcfg=true means UV-derived tokens can request the authenticatorConfig permission; the option may only appear with authnrCfg.
matrix_desc_uv_bio_enroll: uvBioEnroll=true means UV-derived tokens can request the bio-enrollment permission; the option may only appear with bioEnroll.
matrix_desc_uv_configured: Built-in user verification is supported and presently configured.
matrix_desc_uv_count_since_last_pin_entr: Internal UV attempts since the last successful PIN entry, including failed attempts.
matrix_desc_uv_modality: Built-in UV modality hint used by platforms for user prompts; ClientPIN must not be included.
matrix_desc_uv_not_configured: Built-in user verification is supported but not presently configured.
matrix_desc_vendor_config_commands: Supported vendorPrototype authenticatorConfig command identifiers; an empty reported list is allowed.
matrix_desc_vendor_interface: Physical interface reported by normalized vendor metadata.
matrix_desc_versions: Protocol version strings from getInfo; CTAP 2.3 defines FIDO_2_3 and explicitly does not define FIDO_2_2.
matrix_desc_yubico_auto_eject_timeout: Auto-eject timeout value reported by Yubico device information.
matrix_desc_yubico_challenge_response_ti: Challenge-response timeout value reported by Yubico device information.
matrix_desc_yubico_effective_firmware: Behavioral firmware version used for development or preview firmware.
matrix_desc_yubico_fips: Whether the device identifies itself as a FIPS model.
matrix_desc_yubico_fips_approved: Applications reported as currently FIPS approved.
matrix_desc_yubico_form_factor: Physical connector and enclosure shape reported by the YubiKey.
matrix_desc_yubico_fps_version: Firmware version reported for the fingerprint sensor.

overview_signal_always_uv_tooltip: CTAP option alwaysUv. When true, the authenticator requires user verification for operations that would otherwise allow it to be optional.
overview_signal_authnr_cfg_tooltip: CTAP option authnrCfg. Reports support for authenticatorConfig commands used by policy and maintenance flows.
overview_signal_client_pin_tooltip: CTAP option clientPin. true means Client PIN is supported and set; false means PIN support exists but no PIN is currently set.
overview_signal_cred_mgmt_tooltip: CTAP option credMgmt. Enables listing, updating, and deleting discoverable passkeys through the app.
overview_signal_large_blobs_tooltip: CTAP option largeBlobs. Reports the authenticatorLargeBlobs command path; extension-based largeBlob details remain in the matrix.
overview_signal_pin_uv_auth_token_toolti: CTAP option pinUvAuthToken. Supports permission-scoped tokens after PIN or built-in UV for protected CTAP operations.
overview_signal_rk_tooltip: CTAP option rk. The authenticator can create discoverable passkeys found without an allowList. This does not imply passkey management support.
overview_signal_set_min_pin_length_toolt: CTAP option setMinPINLength. Reports support for setting a minimum Client PIN length policy.
overview_signal_up_tooltip: CTAP option up. If absent, CTAP treats user presence as supported by default; false means the authenticator cannot test touch or presence.
overview_signal_uv_tooltip: CTAP option uv. Built-in user verification, such as a biometric sensor, reported separately from Client PIN.
overview_signals_description: The advanced view shows raw GetInfo options together with their interpretation in the app. The capability matrix below contains the complete set of reported values and their sources.

passkey_directory_description: When enabled, Telesma downloads a signed public catalog from Passkey Directory and uses its local cached copy for up to 3 days before refreshing it. RP IDs, usernames, credential IDs, and authenticator details are matched locally and are not sent. Passkey Directory can see your IP address and standard HTTP request metadata. Its community-maintained data may be incomplete or outdated and is not a security indicator.
